name: task_compile_manager
description: Compile a natural-language task request into workflow IR (`task_ir_v1`). Use this when the user explicitly asks to compile/convert/create a task workflow or spec output, NOT when they want to execute a task immediately.

inputs.name: task
inputs.description: Task text to compile into workflow IR.

outputs.description: Structured tool result payload — compiled task spec / IR.

arguments_prompt:
Arguments to task_compile_manager are:
- task: required task text to compile.
- information: optional supporting context and constraints.
